findings: candidate membership grows linearly with relevant verification surfaces in the adversarial scale corpus
the dominant residual is per-candidate verification projection/reference-strength work, not repository-path classification or final top-N sorting
symbols_for_paths_many is already one bounded batched store read for the candidate set; replacing it with per-path reads would regress store economics
classify_repository_path is already bounded process-local lru_cache path-only derived metadata
historical AST reuse and pytest projection reuse from HM25-R remain justified and effective
no safe additional cache/batching change is admitted from this measurement alone because reducing candidate evaluation requires a semantics-preserving cheap prefilter proof
